svg.desc: Structured pruning: each MLP hidden channel owns a gate row, an up row and a down column; channels are ranked by the Fisher-weighted squared weight they own, the least important quarter is removed, and the narrower model is exported and measured, optionally followed by a distilled recovery adapter.
svg.text: brain prune: whole channels removed, a smaller dense model written out
Qwen3-0.6B, keep 75% of every layer's MLP hidden channels (d_ff 3072 -> 2304).
before: each layer's MLP, one bar per hidden channel
gate rows
up rows
down columns
ranked: the least important quarter is removed (dashed)
gate rows
up rows
down columns
Ranking a channel
removing channel c zeroes its gate row, up row and down column, so
importance[c] = 1/2 sum F w^2 over those weights (the same estimate
as the format search, with the whole weight as the error).
A model with those slices zeroed computes exactly what the narrower
model computes, so the plan is measured before anything is exported,
then written as a checkpoint with the base's tokenizer.
Measured
parameters 596 M -> 530 M
held-out loss through the serving engine 3.2101 -> 3.5217
40-step recovery adapter (distilled from the original): 3.5221 -> 3.5038
